ios.desc:
NeatList it's a super productive task list manager that allows you to keep control of your activities in the most effective way.

Flexible: you can create as many lists as you need and fill them with activities and tasks.

Productive: you can upload and download your lists usign iTunes file sharing, the lists are plain text files that you can hand edit, manage and sync with your computer. Works perfectly online and offline. Write your lists, share them and save them when you are online.

Integrated: integrated with dropbox to keep all your lists and checks in synch with all your devices, optionally use a shared dropbox directory. Share and import by mail.

Effective: you can send the lists by mail as attachments.

Safe: own your data, no monthly plan to purchase, no proprietary file format to enslave your data. Just text files and free, open services.

Pleasant: with a clean interface and skins (background image + window color)

Download it now.




What can you do with this app?

Share your shopping lists with your partner, edit from pc, sync with mobile
Project list shared with coworkers
Todo list with checkbox
Presents and travel checklists
